_doc: Effects C/D/H/L (+ P shield_block, comparison only) on the rebuilt board (2026-11-03 rebuild, locked/final). Times in ms at 60 fps; phases are [start, end] ms; flash, loudness, settle, layer and guard are measured per skin on the 60 fps frames (see NOTES_CDHL.md "2026-11-03 rebuild", method).

rebuild_2026_11_03.layer: every effect draws under the HUD and the hand (f1_render.SPLIT below / above); only fx_hp_through, fx_refund, fx_trace_add may draw above the HUD (review 1.6)
rebuild_2026_11_03.loudness_metric: peak over the 60 fps frames of sum(L*/100) over the pixels where the frame differs (dE76 > 5) from both the frame without the effect and the settled frame (the transient); unit full-value px

p_stock.why: review 3.10: the FX-P plate on its own stock, a pink-tinted paper, not the card bone PAPER #F2EEE4

loudness_order_neutral.rule: damage > kill > block > state (gain ranks with state)

loudness_order_solace.rule: damage > kill > block > state (gain ranks with state)

loudness_order_meridian.rule: damage > kill > block > state (gain ranks with state)

fx_grow.title: A unit grows one more hit
fx_grow.easing_summary: in ease-in-out scan line; hold = 4-frame flash on the new chevron; no out (the chevron is the post-state)

easing.flash: step (4 frames, 40 % on the new mark)

keyframes.caption: flash on the new hollow chevron only

fx_grow.reduce_motion: No scan or flash: the hollow chevron fades in over 200 ms (ease-in-out).
fx_grow.source: f2 Packet 5 (ring +1, sector 0); post-state rendered with one more landing hit (land_hit = hit + 1), which the board draws as the hollow growth chevron
fx_grow.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_ward_on.title: Ward applies to units in the Adjuster sector
fx_ward_on.easing_summary: in ease-in-out scan line; hold = 4-frame flash on the lozenge; out ease-out ping

keyframes.caption: gold scan line in the Adjuster sector

fx_ward_on.reduce_motion: No scan, flash or ping: the lozenge fades in over 200 ms.
fx_ward_on.source: f2 Packet 6 (ring +2, warded) next to the Adjuster (ring +1, sector 2); pre-state rendered unwarded
fx_ward_on.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_gun_hit.title: Gun shot hits a unit
fx_gun_hit.easing_summary: in ease-out tracer + ease-out-back burst; out linear fade
fx_gun_hit.reduce_motion: Tracer and burst appear at full size for 300 ms, then fade 200 ms; no speed lines, no shards; the tick goes gone on the same frame.
fx_gun_hit.source: f2 guns: sector 0 BURST, 2 shots hit Worm 2 (shot 1 shown)
fx_gun_hit.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_strike.title: Strike card hits for 2
fx_strike.easing_summary: in ease-out slash + ease-out-back burst; out linear
fx_strike.reduce_motion: Slash and burst shown full at once for 300 ms, fade 200 ms; no speed lines or shards.
fx_strike.source: latent (Strike is not in this hand): Strike (2) on Packet 7, ring +2 sector 5
fx_strike.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_trigger_hit.title: Trigger hits units along its path
fx_trigger_hit.scope: cell-wide, one hit frame per struck cell
fx_trigger_hit.easing_summary: in linear ignition front to back; bursts ease-out back; out linear
fx_trigger_hit.reduce_motion: Route shown painted at once; the two bursts appear together for 300 ms, no speed lines.
fx_trigger_hit.source: f2 trigs: Trigger resolves Payload 4, its hits land on Packet 1 in sectors 3 and 4 (tlog trig_unit)
fx_trigger_hit.layer: under the HUD and the hand
fx_trigger_hit.in_sequence: In the resolve beat fx_commit has already burned the pencil route and Xs into paint, so the sequenced fx_trigger_hit draws only the hit frames and speed lines (same clock: s3 at 120, s4 at 240); the pencil-yellow ignite plays only when the effect runs without a commit before it (O-30, retimed 2026-11-03 rebuild).

fx_kill.title: A unit dies
fx_kill.easing_summary: in 2-frame step flare + ease-out-back burst; out linear, cell empties ease-in-out
fx_kill.reduce_motion: No flare: a 30 % pink-tint disc holds on the token for 200 ms while the burst shows; the cell empties with a 220 ms fade.
fx_kill.source: f2: Worm 2 dies to the sector 0 guns (fate dies); post-state rendered with Worm 2 and its shots removed (empty cell)
fx_kill.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_ricochet.title: Shot glances off armour (steel)
fx_ricochet.easing_summary: in ease-out tracer; glint sine; out linear
fx_ricochet.reduce_motion: Tracer and glint shown still for 300 ms; no sparks.
fx_ricochet.source: latent (no armoured unit in E10): stand-in steel cap drawn on Packet 5
fx_ricochet.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_ricochet_gold.title: Shot weakened by the ward (gold)
fx_ricochet_gold.easing_summary: in ease-out tracer; streak ease-out; out linear
fx_ricochet_gold.reduce_motion: Tracer and the full streak shown still for 300 ms.
fx_ricochet_gold.source: f2 guns: sector 4 BURST, 2 shots warded by Packet 6 (result ward, h 0)
fx_ricochet_gold.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_firewall_burn.title: Firewall burns a sector
fx_firewall_burn.easing_summary: in ease-out rise, 60 ms ring stagger; hold with a 7 Hz height flicker; out linear

easing.flicker: sine 7 Hz on tongue height (no luminance swing)

keyframes.caption: peak: a band per ring, 60 % deep

fx_firewall_burn.reduce_motion: All three bands appear at full height at once, no flicker, hold 300 ms, fade 200 ms.
fx_firewall_burn.source: latent (Firewall is not in this hand): Firewall (2) on sector 0; Packet 5 loses its 2 ticks
fx_firewall_burn.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_hit_land.title: Landing hit, one slice pip lost
fx_hit_land.easing_summary: in ease-in chevrons, 2-frame frame flash, ease-out flood; out linear
fx_hit_land.reduce_motion: No chevron travel or krackle: the flood holds at 80 % density for 300 ms and fades; the pip goes dark on the same frame.
fx_hit_land.source: f1 Packet 1 lands on sector 3 SHIELD (3 hits, 1 pip through)
fx_hit_land.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_hit_land_worm.title: Hit-land variant: worm wear (hook mark)
fx_hit_land_worm.reduce_motion: As the parent; the hook appears without overshoot.
fx_hit_land_worm.source: f1 Worm 3 lands (wear flag); shown on sector 3
fx_hit_land_worm.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_hit_land_adjuster.title: Hit-land variant: Adjuster strike (gold rim flash)
fx_hit_land_adjuster.easing_summary: as fx_hit_land; one sine gold flash
fx_hit_land_adjuster.reduce_motion: As the parent; the gold rim shows as a thin outline, no flash.
fx_hit_land_adjuster.source: latent: Adjuster strike (adj.strike false in E10)
fx_hit_land_adjuster.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_shield_break.title: Our shield slice breaks while blocking
fx_shield_break.easing_summary: in ease-out load + crack; shards ease-out + gravity; dark ease-in-out (stays)
fx_shield_break.reduce_motion: No shard flight or krackle: the plate shows split in place (shards offset 55 %) for 300 ms; flood at 70 %; the wedge darkens in one 300 ms fade.
fx_shield_break.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_slice_crack.title: Slice goes 2 to 1 (cracked)
fx_slice_crack.reduce_motion: No flood pulse or tip spark: the crack draws in 150 ms linear.
fx_slice_crack.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_slice_break.title: Slice goes to 0, ability lost

keyframes.caption: X stamps in the outer corner

fx_slice_break.reduce_motion: No flood or overshoot: black-out, X and halftone fade in together over 300 ms.
fx_slice_break.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_hp_through.title: HP gets through, diamonds fly to YOU
fx_hp_through.scope: arc to HUD (crosses the HUD: allowed)
fx_hp_through.easing_summary: in ease-out lift + ease-in-out flight, 20 ms stagger; hold = sine slap; out linear

keyframes.caption: flight on one curve, ribbon trail
arrival: the strip takes the slap

fx_hp_through.reduce_motion: No flight: the six hatched segments go dark in a 200 ms fade, no slap.

fx_refund.title: Trigger-kill refund, +1 RAM
fx_refund.scope: cell to HUD (crosses the HUD: allowed)
fx_refund.easing_summary: in ease-out-back pop; hold = ease-in-out flight; out ease-out ring

keyframes.caption: lands: RAM coin and REFUND tab

fx_refund.reduce_motion: No flight: the coin fades at the refund mark (150 ms) and the RAM slot and tab show at once.
fx_refund.source: f2: Trigger kills Packet 1, refund 1 RAM (ram 3 + 1)

fx_clear.title: Nothing gets through (arc check)
fx_clear.easing_summary: in ease-out-back stamp; out linear glow
fx_clear.reduce_motion: No stamp, glow or sparkles: the check shows at once.
fx_clear.source: f2: Worm 3 lands on sectors 1-2, soaked and braced, THROUGH 0
fx_clear.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_repair_mend.title: Repair mends one pip
fx_repair_mend.easing_summary: in ease-out rise, sine width; pip ease-in-out; out linear glow
fx_repair_mend.reduce_motion: No strokes or glow: two static plus signs and the pip fills over 200 ms.
fx_repair_mend.source: latent (REPAIR slice mend preview, sector 5); mend-pending pip drawn as a stand-in
fx_repair_mend.layer: under the HUD and the hand

fx_shield_block.title: Our shield slice blocks (for the comparison only)
fx_shield_block.easing_summary: in ease-out chevrons; sparks ease-out; out linear

keyframes.caption: peak: white sparks off the plate

fx_shield_block.reduce_motion: Plate still; no sparks or jolt.
fx_shield_block.source: same sector as the break (sector 1) so the two read side by side
fx_shield_block.layer: under the HUD and the hand
